issues.description: package_info() sets cpp_info.libs but does not set cpp_info.bindirs. The recipe enables --enable-tools (building gpiodetect, gpioget, gpioinfo, gpiomon, gpionotify, gpioset) and notes.md lists these as deliverables, but consumers will not discover the CLI binaries without bindirs=['bin']. The library functionality itself is unaffected.
issues.fix_suggestion: Add self.cpp_info.bindirs = ['bin'] in package_info() if the CLI tools are intended to be consumable, or document that tools are built but not exposed via cpp_info (e.g. for debugging only).

issues.description: manifest.yaml uses a nested 'build:' structure (build.system: autotools) instead of the flat top-level 'build_system:' field specified in code_style rule 14. All required fields (name, version, status, build_system info) are present, but the nesting deviates from the documented format.
issues.fix_suggestion: Use the flat format: build_system: autotools at the top level, or confirm that the project has adopted the nested format as a new standard.

issues.description: commands.json description says 'Linux GPIO device interaction library with command-line tools' and type is 'library'. While this is consistent with package_type='library' in conanfile.py, the description mentioning 'command-line tools' with type 'library' is a minor inconsistency. Since cpp_info.bindirs is not set and package_type is 'library', R38 does not strictly require commands.json, so this is informational only.
issues.fix_suggestion: Either remove 'with command-line tools' from the description, or if tools are meant to be exposed, set type to 'tool' and add cpp_info.bindirs in conanfile.py.

issues.description: test_package_tests entry for test.c has description 'Verify gpiod_api_version() returns valid version string' but test.c actually tests 4 things: API version, line_settings (new/set_direction/get_direction), is_gpiochip_device, and chip_open. The description is incomplete. Additionally assertion_count is 3 but test.c contains 4 test blocks.
issues.fix_suggestion: Update description to 'Verify libgpiod C API: version, line settings, device detection, and chip open' and set assertion_count to 4.
